A 150 W heater is used to keep water boiling under standard atmospheric pressure. In 5.0 min, 16 g of water boils away. Assume no heat loss to the surroundings.

(b) Energy lost by the sphere equals energy gained by the water: C(100−22) = 0.100(4200)(22−20), hence C = 10.8 J °C-1.

2021|paper-1b|2.question:
A diver at sea level sends a sound pulse vertically downwards. The pulse returns from a seabed 30 m below after 0.040 s.

(a) Find the speed of sound in sea water. (2 marks)

A rigid metal cylinder of volume 0.012 m³ contains compressed gas at 18.5 atm and 27 °C at sea level. At the seabed the pressure outside is 4.0 atm and the gas temperature in the cylinder is 20 °C. Take 1 atm = 1.01 × 10⁵ Pa.

(c)(i) Show that filling one balloon lowers the cylinder pressure by 5.0 atm. (2 marks)

2021|paper-1b|2.reasoning:
(a) The pulse travels 60 m in 0.040 s, so v = 60/0.040 = 1.50×103 m s-1.
(b)(i) At fixed volume, p1/T1 = p2/T2. Thus p2 = 18.5(293/300) = 18.1 atm.
(ii) Cooling reduces the molecules' mean kinetic energy and speed, so collisions with the cylinder wall are less frequent and/or less forceful; the pressure decreases.
(c)(i) Conservation of gas amount at the same temperature gives 18.1(0.012) = p(0.012) + 4.0(0.015), hence p = 13.1 atm: a drop of 5.0 atm.
(ii) Each balloon lowers the cylinder pressure by 5.0 atm. The sequence is 18.1 → 13.1 → 8.1 atm; a third full balloon would take the cylinder below 4.0 atm. Therefore 2 complete balloons can be filled.

(b) From the graph, slope = 25 m s-2 kg-1. Since a = mg/(M+0.100), slope = g/(M+0.100), giving M = 9.81/25−0.100 = 0.292 kg ≈ 292 g.

Eddy currents are induced by changing magnetic fields. They flow in closed loops in conductors, like swirling eddies in a stream, and their planes are perpendicular to the magnetic field. They are commonly applied in contactless braking (“eddy braking”) and in induction cookers. The resistance of the conductor causes Joule heating. In motors and transformers this heating is wasteful, so eddy currents are minimized. Cracks or slits prevent closed loops and therefore reduce the induced current. (c) Laminate the iron core into insulated sheets to interrupt large current loops.
(d) A crack interrupts the closed eddy-current paths, reducing the current and hence the magnetic field it produces; the measured decrease reveals the defect.

Each optical fibre in an endoscope consists of a core enclosed by a cladding. Which descriptions about an optical fibre are correct?

2021|paper-2|4.S.question:
(a) Roger wears bifocal spectacles. The upper half has power −1.0 D and the lower half +2.0 D. With the spectacles, his near point is 25 cm and his far point is infinity. The lenses are close to his eyes.

Figure 4.1

(a)(i) State which half is used for viewing distant objects and determine Roger’s unaided far point. (2 marks)

(a)(ii) An object O is 25 cm in front of the lens. (1) Complete the ray diagram to show where the image forms on the retina, and indicate the unaided near point N. (2 marks) (2) Find the distance of N from the eye. (2 marks)

Figure 4.2

(b) An ultrasound A-scan of an eye is shown. The labelled echoes correspond to interfaces A to D.

Figure 4.3

(b)(i) Determine the thickness of the eye lens. Take the speed of ultrasound in the lens as 1520 m s⁻¹. (2 marks)

(b)(ii) State whether 3 MHz or 15 MHz ultrasound is preferred and explain. (1 mark)

(b)(iii) State one medical application of ultrasound other than imaging. (1 mark)
2021|paper-2|4.S.reasoning:
(a)(i) The upper −1.0 D half corrects distant vision. Its focal length is −1.0 m, so Roger's unaided far point is 1.0 m.
(ii) (1) The +2.0 D lower half forms a virtual image at Roger's unaided near point N; complete the ray so the eye focuses it on the retina and mark N 50 cm in front of the eye. (2) With u = 0.25 m and v = −d, 1/f = 1/u + 1/v gives 2.0 = 4.0−1/d, so d = 0.50 m.
(b)(i) The lens echoes are separated by about 5 μs, so thickness = ½cΔt = ½(1520)(5×10-6) = 3.8×10-3 m = 3.8 mm.
(ii) Use 15 MHz: attenuation is acceptable over the shallow eye and its shorter wavelength gives better spatial resolution.
(iii) One valid use is breaking kidney stones, cataract surgery, dental scaling, tumour ablation, or therapeutic promotion of healing.
